يبتسروا (form VIII)
# يَبْتَسِرُوا (yabtasirū) /jab.ta.si.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# يُبْتَسَرُوا (yubtasarū) /jub.ta.sa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
